title: Cranberry Songpyeon
description: A sweet and tangy twist on traditional Korean songpyeon, these dumplings are filled with a sweet cranberry and juicy filling.

ingredients.name: Songpyeon dough
ingredients.notes: available at Korean markets or online

instructions: Combine cranberry filling mixture, sugar, salt, and Korean chili flakes in a bowl.
Divide songpyeon dough into small pieces and roll out into thin circles.
Place a tablespoon of cranberry filling mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Increase heat to high and add 2 tablespoons of water to the skillet.
Cover the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through.
